fast.why: Today is Tuesday, the last day of Jamadilawal. Jamadilakhir begins tomorrow (11 Nov). Next sunnah fast is Thursday 12 Nov. The Prophet ﷺ fasted Mondays and Thursdays.

blessing: Coming home safe after another investigation shift. When you walk through the door today, pause and say Alhamdulillah, then make a short dua of protection for colleagues still on duty.

verse.text: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

hadith.text: Look at those who stand at a lower level than you but don't look at those who stand at a higher level than you, for that is better-suited that you do not disparage Allah's favors.

lesson.title: Seerah part 3: the first revelation in the Cave of Hira
lesson.text: At forty, after years as a truthful merchant and husband, the Prophet ﷺ began to love seclusion in the Cave of Hira, worshipping Allah alone (Sahih al-Bukhari 3; Ar-Raheeq Al-Makhtum). There Jibril came and said "Iqra'" — Read — and after being pressed three times, the first verses of the Quran were revealed: "Read in the name of your Lord who created" (96:1-5). He returned trembling to Khadijah (RA); she covered him and said Allah would never disgrace him, because he kept family ties, spoke the truth, and helped those in need. She took him to Waraqah ibn Nawfal, who confirmed this was the same angel sent to Musa. The deen began with reading, and with someone who recognised goodness; even a few verses today continue that first Iqra'.

quote.text: Say this prayer. "Almighty. Grant me contentment. Don't let my mind believe that everyone seems to have a better life than I do. Teach me to be grateful for all that You have given me and all that You took away. Aameen."

name.text: The first revelation pointed to this quality: "Read, and your Lord is the Most Generous" (96:3). He teaches what we did not know and gives without us earning the right to it. Ask Him today for a little more beneficial knowledge.
He guided the Prophet ﷺ from trembling in the cave to certainty. When a case or a day feels unclear, ask Al-Hadi to show the next right step. "And sufficient is your Lord as a Guide and a Helper."

quote.text: Five more minutes... We've all said it. Then the hours disappear, and the Qur'an waits for later. One more scroll becomes one more hour. Then one more year. But it's never too late to change. Start smaller than you think. A few verses tonight, then come back tomorrow.

world.text: Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists set it at 85 seconds to midnight on 27 Jan 2026, the closest ever, citing nuclear risk, AI and great-power rivalry.
Forecasters' chance of a 'World War Three' before 2050 (10M+ deaths, major powers involved).
Prof Jiang's latest lectures on geopolitics and where great-power conflict is heading.

Nuclear deterrence makes all-out war a losing move for every major power, so the stable outcome (flashing) is 'compete, don't fight': trade wars, arms races and proxy conflicts. The real danger is a misread in a crisis like Taiwan or Ukraine, which is why the clock and the forecast are rising. Meter: 2 of 5.
